sloka: दृश्यते न स मायावी शक्रजित्समितिञ्जयः ।विद्यावानपि येनेन्द्रो मायया नीयते बलात् ।। ७.२९.३१ ॥
transliteration: dṛśyate na sa māyāvī śakrajitsamitiñjayaḥ ।vidyāvānapi yenendro māyayā nīyate balāt ।। 7.29.31 ॥

translations.english: The illusionist Indrajit, the conqueror in battle, is not seen, by whom even the knowledgeable Indra is being led away by force through illusion.
